people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.line: Father of Bathsheba, wife of Uriah the Hittite

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Son of David and Bathsheba, ancestor of Jesus.

people.name: Shammua
people.line: Son of David born in Jerusalem

people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.
